text: The system shall allow users to reset their password via email.
The system must respond to user requests within 2 seconds.

The application must support up to 500 concurrent users.
The system shall allow users to search for products by keyword.
The system shall allow users to create a new account using their email address.

The system shall allow users to bookmark articles for later reading.
The system shall allow users to add and remove items from their shopping cart.
The system shall allow users to follow and unfollow other users.
The system shall allow notifications to be sent when a user's post receives a comment.

The system must load the homepage within 3 seconds under normal network conditions.

The system must be available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
The system must store user passwords in encrypted form only.

The system must recover from a server failure within 5 minutes.
The system must be compatible with the latest versions of major web browsers.
The system must process payment transactions within 5 seconds.
The system must not exceed 60% CPU utilisation under peak load.
The system must comply with GDPR data protection regulations.
The system must ensure 99.5% uptime annually.
The system's user interface must be fully navigable using a keyboard.
The system must be able to scale horizontally when new servers are added.
The system must log all authentication attempts for auditing purposes.
The system must maintain data consistency in the event of concurrent updates.
The system must encrypt all data transmitted between client and server using HTTPS.
The system must remain functional during maintenance through redundant failover servers.
The system must return search results within 1 second for typical queries.
The system must ensure data is backed up at least once every 24 hours.
The system's documentation must be updated within 1 week of any major release.
The system must meet WCAG AA accessibility standards for all interactive elements.
The system must operate correctly on devices with screen sizes ranging from 4 to 27 inches.
The system must retain user activity logs for a minimum of 90 days.
The system must generate error logs for all unexpected failures.
The system must allow new modules to be added without requiring downtime.
